content: Primary Anny and CLAD-Body package sources show Anny 0.6 is a current upstream release with changed rig/topology/pose defaults and a larger dependency surface, while the project deliberately pins anny 0.3.1 for the CLAD 0.6.1 pose parameterisation. CLAD-Body 0.6.1 is a Python >=3.12 Apache-2.0 package for Anny anthropometry, uses ISO 8559-1-style convex-hull circumferences, supports only/preset selection, and documents computation cost differences. Retain the tested pins and Python 3.12; do not upgrade Anny without adapter and measurement contract tests.
